claims.evidence: Photo 2 control panel text reads 'SHARP AR-9201', not AR-M201 - model number mismatch.
No power-on, copy output, or scan test shown in any photo.
General wear/condition cannot be judged reliably from these angles; no close-ups of casing, rollers, or internals.
No accessories, cables, or trays shown beyond the document feeder tray in photo 2.

risks.risk: Model identity mismatch - seller says AR-M201, panel shows AR-9201, these may be different machines with different specs/value
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the full model/serial label on the rear or side panel, matching the control panel text
risks.if_unproven: price as the witness-identified model (AR-9201) only, not the seller's claimed model

risks.risk: Unknown working condition - copier may not power on or may jam/error
risks.proof: Video clip of the unit powering on and producing a test copy or scan
risks.if_unproven: price as non-functional / for-parts worst case

risks.risk: Toner and drum condition/consumable life unknown
risks.proof: Photo of opened toner/drum compartment and a sample printed page
risks.if_unproven: price as needing full consumable replacement

risks.risk: Unknown usage history / page count, which affects remaining machine life
risks.proof: Photo of the service/total page counter on the control panel or service menu
risks.if_unproven: price as high-mileage/heavily used worst case

risks.risk: Missing trays, cables, or accessories not visible in photos
risks.proof: Photos of all paper trays, power cable, and any network/USB cable included
risks.if_unproven: price as incomplete unit, accessories not included

risks.risk: Hidden physical or internal damage (wiring, rollers, boards)
risks.proof: Photos/video of the open side panels and internal mechanism
risks.if_unproven: price as unverified internal condition, worst case

proof_requests: Close-up of the rear/side nameplate showing full model and serial number
Video of the unit powering on and completing a test copy
Photo of the service page-count counter
Photos of all paper trays, power cord, and any accessories included
Photo of toner/drum compartment and a sample printed page
response.reason: The witness clearly identified a Sharp photocopier (panel reads AR-9201, contradicting the seller's stated AR-M201), so it can be priced at worst case as that model with unverified functional condition pending proof.
